procedure.name: apply-pseudo-class-styling
procedure.step: For each interactive element (buttons, links, highlighted tags), ensure :active and :hover styles exist
Review remaining pseudo-classes (:checked, :disabled, :enabled, :invalid, :valid, :empty, :nth-child, :nth-of-type, :required) and add styling where it improves UI/UX

procedure.name: apply-pseudo-element-styling
procedure.step: Add styling for those that improve UX (e.g., ::selection with brand color, ::placeholder with muted tone)

procedure.name: modernize-scss
procedure.step: Convert flat selectors to nested SCSS structure
Extract repeated values into SCSS variables
Extract repeated rule blocks into @mixin definitions
Add modern visual effects: box-shadow, text-shadow, subtle gradients, border-radius

procedure.name: sort-stylesheet
procedure.step: Sort selectors alphabetically within each scope/nesting level
Within each selector, group rules by function: spacing → fonts → colors → borders → layout → effects
